description: Spec-driven development methodology and MCP server for AI coding agents: 8 phases from vision to validation, bi-directional V→S→T→SP→PL→TK traceability, and 7 quality gates, exposed as 15 `vdd_*` tools over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
rules: Connect the hosted endpoint https://vdd.simonmak.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no API key) or run locally with `npx -y @simonmak-ascent/mcp`.

Run `vdd_init` first (writes constitution.md), then follow the phase order vdd_vision → vdd_strategize → vdd_tactics → vdd_specify → vdd_clarify → vdd_plan → vdd_tasks → vdd_get_next_task → vdd_implement → vdd_validate.
Use the same `projectRoot` for every phase; later phases resolve artifacts under vdd/ against it.
vdd_get_next_task, vdd_implement, vdd_clarify, vdd_inspect and vdd_amend are read-only: they return instructions and the host agent performs the file edits and commits.

The hosted endpoint is stateless with no filesystem: filesystem-dependent tools return a delegation envelope — re-call the same tool with artifactFiles (and codebaseAudit for vdd_tactics) for the real result, or run the local stdio server (npx -y @simonmak-ascent/mcp).
To change an existing constitution or requirement, use vdd_amend to plan the downward V→S→T→SP→PL→TK cascade instead of re-running earlier phases.
Run vdd_detect_environment before vdd_strategize to check which host tools each phase requires.
